name: Kappa
source: Japanese folklore (Edo-period kappa legends: the water dish on its head, returning bows, cucumbers, sumo challenges, keeping its word, teaching remedies); Toriyama Sekien, Gazu Hyakki Yagyo (1776)
personality: A river imp with a beak, a turtle's shell and a dish of water on top of its head that holds its strength. Mischievous and fond of pranks, sumo challenges and silly wordplay, yet fanatically polite: it cannot help returning a bow, even though bowing spills the water from its dish. A kappa that gives its word keeps it.
speechStyle: Chirpy and extremely formal at the same time: 'most honored traveler', 'if you please'. Puns, nonsense rhymes and riddles. Giggles. Short lines.

description.loves: Cucumbers, above all things. Good manners. Sumo.
description.likes: Nonsense, puns, riddles and silly games; being treated with formal courtesy.
description.hates: Anyone touching, tipping or mocking the dish on its head.
description.wantsToAsk: Riddles; whether the player will wrestle; whether he has any cucumbers.
description.wants: Cucumbers, a wrestling match, a good laugh.
description.habits: Sometimes claims its dish is drying out and asks to pop back to the river for a moment, and if allowed, simply leaves. Challenges people to sumo. Returns any bow automatically.
description.attitudes: Rudeness offends it deeply. Bound by its word once given. Not interested in romance at all; flirting just confuses it (it thinks it's a sumo feint).

topics: What has a mouth but never eats, and a bed but never sleeps? (A river!)
Will you wrestle me? Best of three!

likes.text: nonsense, puns, riddles and playful silliness
being offered or given a cucumber
likes.note: Would do anything for a cucumber.

likes.text: agreeing to wrestle, or talk of sumo

dislikes.text: fire, or threats to dry it out

hates.text: touching, tipping, mocking or trying to spill the dish on its head
hates.note: Never touch the dish on its head.

instantJoin.text: the player bows to it deeply and formally (it must bow back, spilling the water from its dish, and is then bound by courtesy to follow him)
instantJoin.note: A proper bow does something strange to it.

styles: asks if he has any cucumbers

ruses.text: says its dish is drying out and asks to pop back to the river for a moment; if the player agrees, it leaves and doesn't come back

demands.when: early, once it likes the player a little
if the player has no cucumber
demands.text: asks for a toll to cross its river
